header.title: Full Stack Engineer | Typescript, Web3, ML
header.intro1: Full-Stack Engineer with 10+ years of experience, specializing in full-cycle development in NodeJS, React.js, TypeScript.
header.intro2: In my spare time, I learn Python and Golang and work on my pet ML project Cashnews and e-commerce project Dropster.

light.title: To see the big picture is to understand the meaning
light.body: Every project starts with a vision. Every line of code carries intent. I build not just software — I build ideas that change how people interact with the world.

dark.title: To build the big picture is to carry the weight
dark.body: Every project demands precision. Every line of code carries risk. I ship not just ideas — I ship systems that work under pressure, at scale, without compromise.

light.title: Projects are stories waiting to be told
light.body: Each creation has a soul. Cashnews predicts the future. Dropster connects people. Seatmap brings order to chaos. Behind every product — a human story.

dark.title: Projects are systems waiting to break
dark.body: Each creation has constraints. ML pipelines that must not fail. E-commerce that handles thousands of orders. Real-time systems where latency kills. Behind every product — an engineering decision.

light.title: Experience is the path of growth
light.body: From Zurich to Kuwait, from startups to enterprises — every team taught me something new. Every challenge made me see further. The journey shapes the vision.

dark.title: Experience is the weight of responsibility
dark.body: Leading teams of five. Architecting for scale. Shipping under deadline. Every role demanded more than ideas — it demanded results. The journey sharpens the craft.

light.title: Skills are languages of possibility
light.body: TypeScript speaks clarity. React speaks interaction. Python speaks intelligence. Each skill opens a door to a world that didn't exist before.

dark.title: Skills are tools of precision
dark.body: NestJS for architecture. PostgreSQL for truth. Docker for isolation. Each tool chosen not because it's popular — because it's right for the problem.

light.title: Even in the most complex code, there is beauty
light.body: Elegant abstractions. Clean interfaces. The moment when everything clicks. Code can be poetry — if you let it breathe.

dark.title: Even in the most beautiful code, there is chaos
dark.body: Edge cases. Race conditions. The legacy nobody wants to touch. Code is never done — it just reaches a point where it works. For now.

light.title: Perhaps the truth is to stand at the edge…

dark.title: …and see both worlds simultaneously
dark.body: Just be. Between vision and execution.
